title: "Nandani-Animint-Gallery"

date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(kableExtra)
  library(rmarkdown)
  library(animint2)
  library(knitr)
  library(DT)
})

if (file.exists('meta.csv')) {
  dt <- read.csv('meta.csv')
  no_of_ani <- dim(dt)[1]
  image_links <- character(no_of_ani)

  for(i in 1:no_of_ani){
    # We use the raw link to the Capture.PNG file
    image_links[i] <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", dt$viz_owner_repo[i], "/gh-pages/Capture.PNG")
  }

  Creator <- strsplit(dt$viz_owner_repo, split="/")
  CreatorName <- sapply(Creator, "[[", 1)
  viz.title <- sapply(Creator, "[[", 2)

  viz.link <- sprintf("https://%s.github.io/%s", CreatorName, viz.title)
  Visualization_Link <- paste0("<a href='", viz.link, "'>", viz.title, "</a>")
  Source_Code <- paste0("<a href='", dt$source, "'>Source Code</a>")
  
  full_data <- data.frame(
    Image = "", 
    Visualization_Link = Visualization_Link,
    Source = Source_Code,
    gh_page_repo = dt$viz_owner_repo
  )

 
  kable(full_data, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    column_spec(1, image = image_links) 
}
```
